description: Defines the AudioStreamRecord class, an internal audio stream implementation using legacy AudioRecord, including methods for opening, closing, reading, and processing audio data, as well as managing buffers and callbacks.

classes.name: AudioStreamRecord
classes.description: An internal audio stream class that uses the legacy AudioRecord API for input streams, providing methods for managing audio data, buffers, and callbacks.

methods.name: AudioStreamRecord
methods.description: Constructor for the AudioStreamRecord class.

methods.name: ~AudioStreamRecord
methods.description: Destructor for the AudioStreamRecord class.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the audio stream with the provided builder configuration.

methods.name: release_l
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the stream.

methods.name: close_l
methods.description: Closes the stream.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp for the current audio frame position.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads audio data into the provided buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size in frames.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the current buffer size.

methods.name: getXRunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of buffer underruns/overruns.

methods.name: getFramesWritten
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames written.

methods.name: processCommands
methods.description: Processes any pending commands.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the stream, which is input.

methods.name: processCallback
methods.description: Handles callback events.

methods.name: processCallbackRecord
methods.description: Handles callback operations specific to recording.

methods.name: incrementClientFrameCounter
methods.description: Increments the client's frame counter based on frames read.

methods.name: maybeConvertDeviceData
methods.description: Converts device audio data if necessary.

methods.name: requestStart_l
methods.description: Starts the audio stream, requires lock.

methods.name: requestStop_l
methods.description: Stops the audio stream, requires lock.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurstFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the number of frames per burst from the device.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer capacity from the device.
